reviews.title: Amazing smell that lasts a long time!
reviews.body: I bought this project for my 1 bedroom apartment and was very surprised for the quality that I got for the price. the scent is strong but not too smokey. It also lasts a long time in my space, burning one full stick created a scent that remained for about 2-3 days in my scape (about 750 square feet). Additionally, the amount of smoke produced was not enough to set off my fire alarms, even after placing the incense directly underneath them. I am a huge fan of this scent and will be trying more from the brand! Highly recommend this product if you have never used incense before!
